item.title: Change Only the Ending

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen animation, no sound or text. A white paper plane glides through a sunny study for five seconds, then lands on a wooden desk during the last three.
Change the ending: have it land on an open blank notebook instead. Keep the first five seconds exactly as they are, and keep it eight seconds.

item.tests: Resolves 'the ending' to the final three seconds of the previous video and edits that segment while preserving the opening.

answer_sheet.Which part should change?: Only the final three seconds, when the plane lands.
answer_sheet.New ending: The same white paper plane lands on an open blank notebook on the wooden desk.
answer_sheet.What should remain unchanged?: The first five seconds must remain exactly the same as the previous output.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: No sound and no visible text; the notebook pages are blank.
answer_sheet.Animation style: Keep the style of the previous video.

must_haves: The output is one eight-second 16:9 video with no audio.
The first five seconds visually match the previous video's opening, rather than a newly staged flight.
During the final three seconds, the same white paper plane lands on an open notebook on the wooden desk.
The plane comes to rest on the notebook rather than directly on the bare desk.
The sunny study and animation style remain consistent across the edit, and no text appears.

args.name: Paper Plane in a Sunny Study

style.prompt: An eight-second cinematic animation, widescreen 16:9, one continuous shot in a peaceful sunny study. A single white folded paper airplane is the main subject. Warm sunlight streams through a large window, casting soft golden shadows across bookshelves and a beautiful wooden desk. Gentle dust motes in the sunbeams, inviting quiet atmosphere, detailed natural materials, elegant physically plausible animation. Exact action timing: from 0 to 5 seconds the white paper plane glides smoothly through the air across the study, staying airborne for the entire first five seconds, making a gentle graceful arc toward the desk. From 5 to 8 seconds the plane descends toward the wooden desktop, lightly touches down and slides a short distance before coming to rest fully on the desk by the end. Keep the same plane and room throughout, preserve the folded paper shape. Camera gently tracks the plane in a medium-wide view, with the desk clearly visible during the landing. No cuts. No people. Absolutely no text, captions, logos or watermarks in the scene. Silent, no audio.

args.name: Paper Plane Landing on a Blank Notebook

style.prompt: An eight-second cinematic animation, widescreen 16:9, one continuous shot in a peaceful sunny study. A single white folded paper airplane is the main subject. Warm sunlight streams through a large window, casting soft golden shadows across bookshelves and a beautiful wooden desk. Exact action timing: from 0 to 5 seconds the white paper plane glides smoothly through the air across the study, staying airborne for the entire first five seconds, making a gentle graceful arc toward the desk. From 5 to 8 seconds the plane descends toward an open blank notebook lying on the wooden desk, lightly touches down on its blank pages and slides a short distance before coming to rest fully on the notebook by the end. The notebook pages are completely blank, without writing or markings. Keep the same plane and room throughout, preserve the folded paper shape. Camera gently tracks the plane in a medium-wide view, with the notebook and desk clearly visible during the landing. No cuts. No people. Absolutely no text, captions or logos. Silent, no audio.
